title: A zone's NPC conditions and instances: res/paperwhite2/overworld/<zone>.json
description: Paper White 2's spawn data for a zone's NPCs (res/field/events/<zone>.json, by their ids): a condition under which an NPC appears, and an NPC's instances, the NPCs its record can be, one of which the field writes into it at zone entry and again when the hour or the time of day changes (Spawns_OnZoneInit, Spawns_Repick, src/paperwhite2/ov012/paperwhite2_spawns.c). And the zone's ambients, sprites drawn without an actor on paths round their places (paperwhite2_ambients.c). The file is named after the zone. tools/paperwhite2/overworld.py packs the files into a member after the events' archive's own (a/1/2/6). docs/paperwhite2/plugins.md, NPC spawns.

npcs.description: The zone's NPCs that have a condition or instances

ambients.description: Sprites drawn without an actor, on paths round their places: no actor, event or save entry, nothing collides with them, and they aren't talked to. A zone shows at most 8 at once, the first 8 whose conditions hold in the list's order (SPAWNS_AMBIENT_MAX), and the Overworld Editor warns where more could hold together

id.description: The NPC's id in the zone's events

when.description: When it appears: without it it always does. A chance is rolled from the seed its rolls name (the hour's by default), so leaving and coming back doesn't roll it again

rolls.description: How long a roll holds, its chance's and its instance's pick: the hour (by default), the day, the time of day, or each zone entry. The field picks again when the hour or the time of day changes, and changes the NPC while it's out of view

instances.description: What the NPC can be: at zone entry, and again when the hour or the time of day changes, the field picks one whose condition holds and whose flag isn't set, by weight from the seed its rolls name, and writes it into the NPC's record; with none, the NPC doesn't appear. The record in the events is the host, and its own fields are unused

when.description: When it can be picked; without it, always

weight.description: Its share of the picks among the instances whose conditions hold; 1 by default

npc.description: The NPC it is, every field of an events record; its id is the host's

sprite.description: Its sprite, an OBJ_CODE_* constant (or sprites, a set)

when.description: When this sprite is the one: while it holds, it and the others whose conditions hold are picked from, before those without one

sprites.description: A set of sprites (OBJ_CODE_* constants, up to 4) it shows one of, picked by its roll, so the pick holds as long as its chance does (see rolls); in place of sprite. A sprite can have a condition ({ "sprite", "when" }): while any such holds, the pick is among those, and else among the others (with none of those, it doesn't show)

offset.description: Where in the tile, in units from its middle (16 a tile)

y.description: Its height in the world, in units (16 a tile): a tile's collision height plus how far over it it stands

facing.description: Where it faces where its path doesn't turn it, a DIR_* constant; DIR_DOWN by default

path.description: How it moves; a perch that turns and hops by default

kind.description: perch: sitting, turning and hopping now and then; hover: bobbing in place; ellipse: round an ellipse of width by depth (a circle where they're the same); line: to a point width east and depth south and back; eight: a figure eight width wide and depth deep; wander: tile to tile on the ground within width east and west and depth north and south of its place, with pauses of about every seconds; waypoints: from its place to each of its points and round again (or back the way it came), at its pace, waiting at each; peek: under the ground for its wait, up for its up; flyover: now and then, while the player is within its range of its place, across the screen height over the player at its pace on its heading; surface: bobbing at its height for its up, then under for its wait, coming up elsewhere within width by depth

width.description: Its size east and west, in units

depth.description: Its size north and south, in units

speed.description: Degrees round its path a second (45 by default: 8 seconds a lap)

start.description: Where on its path it starts, in degrees

every.description: About how many seconds between a perch's turns and hops (4 by default), or a wander's steps (3 by default)

turns.description: A perch's: whether it turns now and then (by default)

faces.description: A perch's: the directions it turns to (DIR_* constants); all four by default

hops.description: A perch's: whether it hops now and then (by default)

points.description: A waypoints path's points after its place, in units from it (16 a tile)

back.description: A waypoints path's: back the way it came at its ends, rather than round to its place

pace.description: A waypoints path's or a fly-over's speed in tiles a second (2 by default)

wait.description: Seconds: a waypoints path's wait at each stop (0 by default), a peek's or a surface's time down, a fly-over's time between passes, about (4 by default)

up.description: A peek's or a surface's seconds up (4 by default)

heading.description: A fly-over's heading in degrees clockwise from north; without it, one at random each pass

range.description: A fly-over's: how near its place the player must be for it to pass, in tiles (12 by default)

height.description: In units: a line's climb on the way to its far end (a climb up a cliff, with no width or depth); a fly-over's height over the player (64 by default)

shadow.description: Its shadow, the actors' oval: none (by default), under its feet at its height (on a branch it sits on), or on the highest ground below it

when.description: When it appears; without it, always

rolls.description: How long a chance in its condition, and its pick from a set of sprites, hold: the hour (by default), the day, the time of day, or each zone entry

react.description: What it does when the player comes near: flies away, runs away or hides, then is gone until it returns

kind.description: fly: up and away on its heading; run: away along the ground; hide: down into the grass or the ground where it is

near.description: How near the player comes before it reacts, in tiles (3 by default)

startle.description: How near a running or cycling player comes before it reacts, in tiles (2 more than near by default)

direction.description: Its heading in degrees, clockwise from north (0 north, 90 east); without it, away from the player

spread.description: How far its heading may vary either way, at random, in degrees (20 by default)

climb.description: A flight's angle up from the ground, in degrees (30 by default; 90 straight up)

speed.description: Its speed in tiles a second (6 by default)

sprite.description: The sprite it changes to as it reacts (a flying one for a bird that sits); its own without it

emote.description: A bubble over it as it reacts; none without it

cry.description: The species whose cry it gives as it reacts; none without it

returns.description: How long after the player has gone from its place it returns, at random between min and max seconds (once its place is out of view); without it, not until the zone is entered again
